detail: Issue of Securities - Dev Accelerator Limited has informed the Exchange about The Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on November 03, 2026, considered and approved the proposal for raising funds through Issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures, in dematerialized form, in one or more series or tranches on a private placement basis for an aggregate amount up to Rs. 300 [(Indian Rupees Three Hundred Crores Only)] ( NCDs ) to eligible investors including individuals, body corporate, corporate entities and other qualified institutional buyers at such price and on such terms and conditions. The Board further empowered the Executive Committee of the Company to complete the issue…
